about.heading: I turn messy, manual work into clean digital systems.
paragraphs: I’m a software engineering graduate with several years inside e-commerce operations — working with large product catalogs, product content and the internal tools that keep them clean.
That background shapes how I work: I build websites that are clear and fast, dashboards that answer real business questions, and automations that remove the repetitive work your team does every week.
workingPrinciples: Clear scope and deliverables before work starts
Regular updates — you always know the status
Clean, documented work you can maintain
Handover guide and agreed support after delivery
